commune: Production sprite atlas for a classic isometric city-building game, using the attached ORIGINAL game sprites as the geometry/proportion reference. Preserve the simple varied utilitarian silhouettes, modest real building heights, and correct 2:1 isometric ground projection of that reference. Upgrade clarity and color, with crisp detailed hand-painted/pixel-like edges that read at small game sizes. No ornate palaces, no giant Georgian courtyard buildings, no repeated teal-roof mansion architecture, no oversized towers. Every subject is on its OWN full diamond ground lot, with EMPTY ground setback around all four lot edges so adjacent roads remain visible. Transparent background outside every lot, no checkerboard, no labels or grid lines. Every cell equal size; generous transparent separation; complete subject fully inside its own cell. Broad varied materials and roof colors: slate gray, muted blue, ochre, brick red, sage green, white plaster, timber, rusty metal. Do not apply one color palette to every building. Match the reference's LOW building-to-lot height. EXACT 3 columns by 3 rows. Rows are THREE DIFFERENT forestry commune variants. Columns are THREE animation poses of the SAME variant, with fixed building geometry and position, only a tiny worker shifting or kiln smoke changing. Each lot represents a four-by-four-tile forestry/charcoal commune: mostly GRASS and a small group of trees, ONE tiny single-story timber forester hut, wood stack and small charcoal pit. Tree canopy and hut occupy the central half of the lot; outer edges stay clear. Row 1: dark timber hut with blue-gray corrugated roof and pines. Row 2: pale ochre work shed with rust-red roof, broadleaf trees, firewood stack. Row 3: cream stone tiny hut with moss-green roof, few mixed trees and a low charcoal mound. These are forestry compounds, not housing campuses or factories. Similar to the Commune in reference top-left but colorful and legible. Keep structures extremely low. No towering chimneys, no fountains.
